title: Law to require accessible swings in city playgrounds
summary: This bill would require the Parks Department to install at least two accessible swings for children with disabilities in half of its playgrounds by December 31, 2033, and in all playgrounds by December 31, 2036. New or newly acquired playgrounds would also need accessible swings. If installation is infeasible due to space, the department must notify the Council Speaker and local Council member in writing.
